message.text: hi tell me about ownership of ecobank especially related to Qatar

response.text:
- Ecobank Transnational Inc. (ETI) is a pan-African banking group with shares traded on multiple West African stock exchanges.
- Qatar National Bank is one of the largest shareholders, owning 20.10% of Ecobank as of December 2021.
- Other significant shareholders include Nedbank Group Limited and Arise B.V.

Ecobank has a notable ownership stake from Qatar National Bank, which is a key player in its shareholder structure.

message.text: i have an error during selfie upload

response.text:
- The error during selfie upload may be due to the selfie not showing a full face clearly.
- Good lighting is essential, and you should avoid backlight and masks.
- Ensure the photo is sharp and in focus, as blurry images can also cause upload issues.

To resolve the error, retake your selfie ensuring your full face is clearly visible, use good lighting, and avoid any obstructions.
